messages:
maria (security): Heads up — vendor request to extend SIEM export retention. Security wants 90d hot -> 365d cold archive for the partner dataset. Also need a short-lived (30m) JIT KMS unwrap flow for forensic analysts. Opening thread before an RFC.

jon (eng-sre): Scope? auth/audit events only, or app traces too?

maria (security): Audit + auth + detection alerts only. Exclude PII-containing application logs. Also propose splitting SIEM roles: `siem_viewer` (read-only dashboards) and `siem_forensics` (can request unwrap).

kevin (platform): We can add the two roles in IAM. JIT unwrap requires KMS policy change — current flow only allows service account unwraps. Suggest leverage `log-jit-service` with HSM-mediated approval and short TTL. 30m OK as baseline but need extension path.

sarah (oncall): For incident triage 30m can be tight when cross-org approvals lag. Can we add a one-click extension to 2 hours with auditor approval? Proposed request template below: 

```yaml
requester: <name>
team: <team>
reason: <short justification>
ticket: <inc/xxxx or jira/xxxx>
scope: [audit, auth, alerts]
expiry_minutes: 30
approver: <security_lead>
metadata: {incident_id: optional}
```

maria (security): Good. Add: audit trail must record who unwrapped, key version, and full request payload. Also require automated alert if one identity requests >3 extensions in 24h :warning:.

audit-bot: Draft policy created: `/policies/siem_jit_unwrap_draft_v0.1` — contains RBAC mappings, KMS policy diff, and ticketing integration. Please review.

kevin (platform): I'll open a PR for IAM roles + KMS policy + ops playbook. Assigning to @maria (security) for review. ETA: EOD tomorrow.

maria (security): Ack. Looping in @legal for retention justification and vendor contract check.
